text:
Ravi Narayan: Quick threadwe have three competing asks from sales: full 6y indexed retention, object-only cold archive with manifests, and a hybrid 'forensics-first' variant that keeps event windows indexed on demand. Need a single roadmap call decision.

Sara Mitchell: TL;DR: go hybrid. Ship object-only cold for everyone + an opt-in searchable-forensics addon for customers that expect heavy e-discovery. It narrows scope for MVP and keeps costs bounded.

Kenji Watanabe: Hybrid notes: object-only cold = WORM objects + manifest.json (SHA256 list + signer) + BYOK support for envelope keys. Searchable-forensics addon = incremental pre-indexing of flagged windows (e.g., 30d slices) so restores are faster for common queries.

Amira Hassan: Legal: key requirements - legal_hold must be able to freeze deletion and persist an immutable event record, removal needs Legal signoff AND audit-entry with justification. For any searchable offering, we must prove completeness to SOC2 auditors (no sampling allowed).

Ravi Narayan: Operational constraints? Kenji, rough restore/rehydration SLA for hybrid vs object-only?

Kenji Watanabe: Object-only: rehydrate subset ~4-8h depending on size, full reindex 24-72h. Searchable-forensics slices: subset search <30m for pre-indexed slices, full-slice reindex <6h. Costs: object-only ~+0.2 USD/active-user-month for 6y; full indexed 6y ~+1.0 USD/active-user-month; hybrid (object + selective slices) depends on slice count.

Sara Mitchell: Pricing idea: base includes object-only cold. Searchable-forensics = monthly surcharge per slice-window OR pay-per-restore. Make searchable slices customizable by tenant (PM UI later).

LegalBot: [system] Detected retention_variant_proposal uploaded by Ravi Narayan  running compliance checklist (checks: legal_hold_override, manifest_signed, byok_flag).

Amira Hassan: Also add: export format for auditors must include manifest signature, key fingerprint, and a notarized snapshot (hash) of the exported package. Exports should be paginated and each page signed.

Ravi Narayan: Example policy config (RFC-ready):
```yaml
retention_variants:
  base_object_only:
    hot_days: 90
    metadata_years: 1
    cold_years: 6
    indexing: object-only
    byok: supported
  searchable_forensics:
    hot_days: 365
    metadata_years: 2
    cold_years: 6
    indexing: windowed
    window_size_days: 30
    byok: required_for_longterm
    legal_hold_enforced: true
```

Kenji Watanabe: Implementation notes: manifest signer service needs HSM-backed key; escrow logs for BYOK wrap/unwrap events; rehydrate pipeline with per-tenant throttles and cost-metering tags. Need an ops quota model to avoid blast during discovery events.

Sara Mitchell: Roadmap proposal: Q3 - ship base_object_only (WORM + manifest + legal_hold API + BYOK plumbing). Q4 - pilot searchable_forensics for 2 customers (UI + billing) + formal restore pricing. GA decision: require BYOK for any >5y retention customer (legal prefers).

Amira Hassan: Legal nod: agree with that timeline. Make removal an explicit two-step API + manual legal approval flow. Also require justification field on apply/remove.

Ravi Narayan: Decision point for tomorrow's sync: approve roadmap split (base_object_only now, searchable_forensics pilot in Q4) and BYOK required-for-GA >5y. Any objections? @Amira Hassan @Kenji Watanabe

Kenji Watanabe: No objections. Will prototype manifest signer and rehydrate cost sim.

Amira Hassan: No objections. I'll draft the legal runbook and the SOC2 export requirements.

Sara Mitchell: I'll write the RFC with cost sims and two pricing models (monthly searchable surcharge vs pay-per-restore) and post to #product-docs EOD.

Ravi Narayan: Awesome. Marking this as "Retention variant: object-only MVP + searchable-forensics pilot" on the board and assigning owners: Sara (RFC/pricing), Kenji (prototype), Amira (legal). Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
